request: Let me mark important tasks and focus on those first

questions.ask: Should marking a task "important" be a simple on/off star (important or not), or do you need multiple priority levels like High/Medium/Low?
questions.why: Determines whether we add a single yes/no flag or a multi-level priority field, which changes both the data stored per task and the marking control shown in the UI.

questions.ask: Should important tasks just move to the top of your existing task list, or would you rather have a separate view/tab that shows only important tasks?
questions.why: Determines whether we just re-sort the single list or build a new filtered view, which is a materially different amount of UI work.

questions.ask: Once you check off an important task as done, should it stay pinned near the top, or drop down with the other completed tasks?
questions.why: Determines the sort/ordering rule (important-and-not-done first, vs. important always first) so finished work doesn't clutter the top of your focus list.

findings.note: Tasks table has only id, title, done (0/1). No 'important' or priority column exists yet; adding one requires a schema/migration change here and wherever tasks.db is created.

GET /api/tasks returns all tasks ordered by id (insertion order) with no sorting logic; PATCH /api/tasks/:id only accepts updating 'done'. Both would need to accept/expose an 'important' field and support reordering by importance.

Client renders tasks in the order the API returns them, with a checkbox for done and no other controls. Adding an importance toggle means adding a new control (e.g. star button) per list item and reflecting it visually.
Only styling hook currently is 'li.done' for strikethrough; no styling exists for importance/priority, so a new visual treatment (e.g. highlight or badge) would need to be defined.

reply: A separate view, not re-sorting the main list. Just on and off, no levels. And it should stay important even after it's done.

spec.summary: Add an on/off "important" flag to tasks, with a separate view that shows only important tasks (main list stays unsorted), and completing a task keeps it marked important.
acceptance: Each task in the main list has a toggle control to mark or unmark it as important.
An Important view/tab exists that lists only tasks currently marked important.
Marking or unmarking a task important does not change its position or order in the main task list.
Checking an important task as done keeps it marked important and it still appears in the Important view.
Unmarking a task as important removes it from the Important view but leaves it in the main list.
unchanged: Main list task order remains insertion order (by id) regardless of importance.
Existing done/undone toggle behavior and strikethrough styling for completed tasks are unaffected.
Tasks without the important flag behave exactly as before.
spec.check: Automated check creates tasks, marks one important via the toggle, verifies it appears in the Important view while main list order is unchanged, marks it done, and verifies it remains in the Important view and marked important.
spec.reviewFocus: Confirm the important flag is persisted independently of done (schema/migration adds a real column, not derived state) so completing a task never clears importance and the Important view reflects the flag directly rather than a re-sort of the main list.
